title: Luxuriant Congee with Chinese Herbs
description: A nourishing and comforting congee dish infused with the subtle flavors of Chinese herbs, ideal for a relaxing breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: Luxuriant Chinese Herbs
ingredients.notes: Dried herbs such as astragalus and licorice root

ingredients.name: Congee
ingredients.notes: Prepared congee or cooked rice porridge

instructions: Rinse the rice and soak it in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the rice, then add it to a large pot with the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the congee and dried Chinese herbs. Cook for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the congee hot, garnished with thinly sliced scallions and a slice of ginger.
